title: Smart Study Calendar
summary: An AI-assisted study planning system for turning weekly goals into focused, adaptive schedules.
techStack: React + Vite, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, Gemini API

sections.heading: What I built
sections.text: I worked on a team project that combines a drag-and-drop weekly calendar, adaptive scheduling, and a focus model to help students plan study blocks around deadlines and workload.

sections.heading: AI feature
sections.text: The app uses Gemini-powered explanations to make schedule decisions easier to understand, turning recommendations into clear guidance instead of opaque automation.

sections.heading: Result
sections.text: This became the strongest portfolio project because it connects modern frontend architecture, a FastAPI backend, AI integration, and a real user workflow.

title: Bone Disease Prediction
summary: A final-year machine learning project focused on predicting bone disease risk with interpretable modeling.
techStack: Java, Decision Trees, Machine Learning, Web/System Implementation

sections.heading: What I built
sections.text: I contributed to model selection, dataset preparation, evaluation, and system implementation for a team-based academic prediction workflow.

sections.heading: Academic context
sections.text: The project was presented through ICIRIAC 2024 and published in AIP Conference Proceedings, giving the work a stronger research and documentation foundation.

sections.heading: Result
sections.text: It strengthened my applied machine learning fundamentals and my ability to connect model behavior with a usable project interface.

title: Full-Stack Music Player
summary: A role-based music platform for streaming tracks and managing a personalized music library.
techStack: React + Vite, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, Howler.js

sections.heading: What I built
sections.text: I built a responsive music platform with streaming and playback controls, song search, favorites, and user-created playlists backed by a REST API and MongoDB.

sections.heading: Role-based experience
sections.text: JWT authentication supports separate User, Creator, and Admin workflows. Creators can upload tracks, while administrators can manage songs, playlists, advertisements, and view analytics.

sections.heading: Result
sections.text: This project expanded the original frontend player into a complete full-stack product, including protected routes, file uploads, music metadata extraction, and persistent user data.

title: Real Time Cryptocurrency Tracker
